imagesets.name: Segmentation Evaluation files - Manual annotation, prediction, raw data files
imagesets.directory: data/Parlakgul et al - Regulation of liver subcellular architecture controls metabolic homeostasis/FIB-SEM Raw and Segmentation Data/Segmentation Evaluation
imagesets.details: The evaluation was performed on down-sampled data. A down-sampled version of the raw data is provided as well. Raw data, manual annotation data and predictions are provided as tiff stacks (8bit or 32bit, compressed, packaged in a .zip container). For lipid droplets, mitochondria, nuclear membrane and ER, we selected 3 test volumes of 300×300×50 voxels at random locations. Object based scores were only calculated for mitochondria and lipid droplets. For ER sheet and tubule evaluation, we randomly choose an area of 750x750 pixel^2 at 4 different locations in each dataset. Raw data, manual annotations and predictions are provided.
